wikipedia_api.user_agent: Always set a User-Agent header, e.g. "WikipediaQA/1.0 (contact@example.com)"

endpoint.name: Search Pages (full-text)
endpoint.description: Searches page titles AND content. Primary endpoint for the search_wikipedia tool. Returns a "pages" array of search_result objects.

responses.response: pages array (may be empty if no results)
Missing q, or limit out of range

endpoint.python_snippet: import requests r = requests.get( "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/rest.php/v1/search/page", headers={"User-Agent": "WikipediaQA/1.0"}, params={"q": "jupiter", "limit": 5}, ) pages = r.json()["pages"] # list of search_result objects

endpoint.name: Autocomplete Page Title
endpoint.description: Matches the START of page titles only. Useful for disambiguation / typeahead before fetching full content.

endpoint.name: Get Page (metadata only)
endpoint.description: Returns page metadata + html_url (link to fetch HTML). No body content. Use for quick existence checks or to get the canonical title.

endpoint.name: Get Page with HTML
endpoint.description: Returns page object with full HTML in the "html" field. Best for extracting readable content to pass as context to Claude.

endpoint.name: Get Page Source (wikitext)
endpoint.description: Returns page object with wikitext in the "source" field.

endpoint.name: Get Page HTML (raw)
endpoint.description: Returns HTML only (text/html, no JSON wrapper).

endpoint.name: Get Language Links
endpoint.description: Array of page_language objects for the same topic in other languages.

schema.description: One item in the "pages" array returned by search endpoints.

fields.field: URL-safe title — use this in /page/{key}/* calls
/search/page: snippet with searchmatch spans, may end mid-sentence. /search/title: page title.

schema.description: Returned by /page/{title}/* endpoints. Content field varies by variant.

fields.field: Present in /bare — URL to fetch HTML

recommended_pattern.name: search_then_fetch
recommended_pattern.step: GET /search/page?q={query}&limit=5 → pick best match by key + description
GET /page/{key}/with_html → strip HTML tags → pass plain text to Claude
recommended_pattern.note: Strip searchmatch spans and HTML before passing content to the model.
Use "description" field for quick disambiguation without a full fetch.
If no good match, reformulate the query and retry.
Subpage titles: encode "/" as "%2F" in the path.
